title: `cldr_currencies()` gives an error when called via `::`
description:
Hi Rich,

thanks for your effort to provide CLDR data for easy use in R.

I'm currently developing a [package](https://github.com/trekonom/countryscales) that uses i18n under the hood. 

I noticed that e.g. `cldr_currencies()` only works when `i18n` is attached via `library`, but gives an error when called via `::`:

``` r
i18n::cldr_currencies()
#> Error in i18n::cldr_currencies(): object 'currencies' not found
```
